headline: Easy breeding chain: Univolt
title: Easy Univolt Breeding Chain in Palworld | 3 Steps From Easy Pals | Palworld Breeding Guide
video_script: This simple breeding chain gets you Univolt, a lightning fast electric mount. Step one: breed Vanwyrm with Woolipop to get Yakumo. Step two: breed that Yakumo with Robinquill to get Wispaw. Step three: breed Wispaw with Dumud, and the egg hatches into Univolt! Every step is checked against Palworld one point zero breeding data. Put each pair on the Breeding Farm with a cake. Which Pal should I chain next? Comment below!
description: Easy 3-step Palworld 1.0 breeding chain to Univolt: Vanwyrm + Woolipop = Yakumo, Yakumo + Robinquill = Wispaw, Wispaw + Dumud = Univolt. Each step verified on PalBreedCalc and with the breeding formula from PinDrop's combi ranks.
